text:
Carla: Quick pre-release checklist for today's 18:00 UTC deployment — patch v2.3.1. Please ack and grab owners for smoke + rollback. Target window 18:00-18:30 UTC.

Carla: Checklist (TL;DR):
- [ ] Code review approvals ✅
- [ ] E2E prod smoke tests ready (owner)
- [ ] Canary + health checks configured
- [ ] Rollback tag and runbook verified (owner)
- [ ] Monitoring alert thresholds reviewed
- [ ] Post-deploy smoke pass (tester)

Ben: I'm on code review approvals, all PRs merged and CI green. Running final lints now.

Jia: I can sign off on infra side and approve the rollout policy. Canary set to 5% for first 10 min then 25%.

Maya: I'll own the smoke tests post-deploy. Test plan is ready, will run API + auth + core write path.

Marcus: I'll own rollback readiness. Created rollback tag: v2.3.1-rollback (sha: ab12ef3). Runbook updated: /runbooks/deploy-rollback.md

Carla: Nice. Can someone paste the smoke test curl commands for ops?

Maya: Sure — smoke commands below, run after canary reaches 5%:
```
# health endpoint (expect 200)
curl -i -H 'Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_TOKEN' https://api.redwood.ai/health || exit 1

# quick write/read (expect match)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/items -d '{"key":"smoke-123","value":"ok"}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_TOKEN'
curl -s https://api.redwood.ai/v1/items/smoke-123 -H 'Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_TOKEN' | grep ok || exit 1
```

Maya: I'll run these and post results in this thread.

ops-bot: Canary health checks configured: route /api/v1/* -> canary 5% for 10m, fallback to stable. Health probe interval 30s.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy window: 2025-10-14T18:00:00Z -> 2025-10-14T18:30:00Z. Auto-rollback enabled on 5xx rate > 2% over 2m.

Carla: Who's on on-call during the window? Need someone for the first 30 mins after deploy for quick rollback if needed.

Ben: I'm on-call 18:00-20:00 UTC, can monitor.

Jia: I'll monitor infra metrics and logs, watching mem/cpu and queue lag.

Marcus: Rollback checklist: stop new traffic, deploy rollback tag v2.3.1-rollback, verify canary/stable health, escalate if DB migrations present. No DB migrations in this release.

Maya: Smoke results (18:06 UTC): health ok, write/read ok, auth token validated. No errors in core service logs for 5 minutes.

Carla: Any outstanding approvals?

Ben: Final sign-off from me: :heavy_check_mark: all good.

Jia: infra sign-off: :white_check_mark: go for deploy.

Carla: Great. @deploy-bot kick at 18:00. Everyone, please be on this thread for the next 30m for updates.

deploy-bot: Deploy job queued — job id: deploy-2025-10-14-1800-1749998888. Will post status updates.

deploy-bot: Deploy started (18:00:05 UTC). Canary batch 1/20 applied.

ops-bot: Canary metrics (18:03 UTC): latency +3ms p95, errors 0.2% — within thresholds.

Maya: Running post-canary smoke now.

Maya: Post-canary smoke (18:05 UTC): PASS — health + write/read ok. No auth regressions.

Carla: All checks green, continue rollout to 25%.

deploy-bot: Rollout to 25% complete (18:08 UTC).

ops-bot: Full rollout health (18:12 UTC): errors 0.1%, lat p95 +4ms. No alerts triggered.

Marcus: Rollback readiness confirmed. Tag prepped and can be promoted in <= 5m if needed.

Ben: Monitoring will watch for error spikes and increased lat. I'll escalate if anything hits thresholds.

Carla: Post-deploy tasks: update release notes, notify support, schedule post-mortem if any regressions.

Carla: Thanks team — marking checklist done.

Ben: Great job.

Jia: Nice and smooth.

Maya: Closing smoke thread, will follow-up if anything crops up.

deploy-bot: Deploy complete (18:15:22 UTC) — status: SUCCESS.

Carla: Officially closed. :tada:
